methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: Considering the 3nm flagship processor, this phone will handle all my work and study needs effortlessly. The performance speed and multitasking efficiency will be unmatched, making it perfect for heavy workflows and complex applications.
construct_responses.EE: The user interface will be incredibly intuitive, with a simple and sleek design. The learning curve will be minimal, ensuring a seamless transition from my current device.
construct_responses.HM: The LTPO AMOLED display will offer vibrant colors and clear visuals, enhancing my gaming and video streaming experience. The 200MP camera will deliver stunning photos and videos, making it a joy to use.
construct_responses.SI: My college friends will be impressed by the build quality and advanced features. It will elevate my social status and make me a tech trendsetter among my peers.
construct_responses.PP: With a hardware security enclave, my data and privacy will be well-protected. The security features will give me peace of mind, knowing that my personal information is safe.
construct_responses.BI: Considering the price of ₹64,999, it fits comfortably within my budget. I am certain I will adopt this smartphone and continue using it as my daily driver; it offers everything I need and more, making it a worthwhile investment.
construct_responses.OVERALL: The Apex Flagship Ultra 5G checks all the boxes for me. With its advanced features and premium build, it's a no-brainer for my needs and budget. I am definitely going to buy and use it.
